blocks.heading: Cycle Myths Checked Against the Bulletin
rows: "Delhi University asks for 55 to 60 per cent in Class 12 for B.Com (Hons)"
DU's 2026-27 Bulletin sets no minimum marks for B.Com (Hons). Merit comes from CUET scores, and the FAQ says Class 12 marks are used only to break ties.
"You can pick the Maths paper in CUET even if you did not study it"
The Bulletin says it is mandatory to appear in CUET in those subjects in which you are appearing or have passed Class 12. A commerce student without maths cannot use Combination I.
"DU takes a separate entrance like DU JAT for commerce"
DU admits through CUET scores and its seat-allocation system. A popular course page still lists DU JAT as a B.Com route, which is out of date.
"CA and CMA are maths-only courses"

ICAI takes registrations from any stream after Class 10. CMA Foundation includes a business-maths paper that you learn inside the course. A ranking page that lists CA and CMA under "with maths" is wrong about CA and misleading about CMA.
"The first cutoff list is the price of admission"
In the 27 colleges we could read, general-category B.Com (Hons) seats were 97.8 per cent filled by the spot round. Cutoffs show who got in first, not who can still get a good seat.
"One bad CUET day means a lost year"
You need a plan with a fallback ready before the exam, not after. Several professional routes and law tests run on their own dates.

B.Com (General), Combination I: language + any three List B subjects (Accountancy, Business Studies, Economics).

blocks.heading: CA, CS and CMA: Timing, Not Eligibility

items.text: CA Foundation: you must register at least four months before the exam.
CMA Foundation: the December 2026 exam is reported for 13 December, with a registration deadline of 10 October and a late-fee window to 17 October.
CSEET (CS entry): ICSI's February 2027 session has conflicting registration dates in public sources, so confirm on icsi.edu before you rely on either.
Choose a five-test CUET set that covers three DU lines at once (see the five-test set above).
Mark the first dates: CLAT on 31 October if law interests you, CMA on 10 October if you want an early start.
Decide by December whether the May 2027 CA Foundation sitting is realistic next to boards and CUET.
Keep one skill project running that is not an exam.
